description: This file defines configuration options and factory functions for creating Slack WebClient instances, including default retry configurations and utility functions for resolving and creating clients with specific options.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Returns WebClientOptions with retryConfig set to default if not provided.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Returns WebClientOptions with retryConfig set to write-specific default if not provided.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Creates a new WebClient instance for Slack with resolved options.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Creates a new WebClient instance for Slack with write retry options.
